affected_queued_tasks.effect: Must use the registered supporting stable ID and public read/self-only private read. It must still implement independent parent antecedent/activity; C01 only proves identity/participation. Do not treat the parent registration as a parent decision.

Must add parent-authored performed decision/action/utterance through an actual writer. C01 participation records only the focal actor's performed world event; it does not make the parent the event author.

Must keep hidden reason separate from performed utterance and Nadia-qualified uptake. Private state is currently a C12 registration episode readable only through the self-only supporting read; outward speech and child receipt remain separate obligations.

Dynamic other-actor registration exists but the role allowlist is parent only. C05 must deliberately extend roles/relations and prove fork/cold relation history; it may not silently relabel the parent as a generic actor.
Situated-field projection must read public supporting/actor access, never the raw world snapshot or private-state episode. Parent/relationship eligibility is not implemented here.
J1 still needs a real parent performed speech/decision distinct from Nadia's uptake. C01 supplies a separate actor identity and perception boundary, not the parent event.
Multi-period parent/Nadia continuity must preserve the same stable parent ID across periods and cold replay. C01 proves only same-clock participation and cold process read.
MI/MII/MIII presentation, exposure and movement remain separate. C01 adds no historical depth, viewer exposure or independent parent movement.
B01 material facts are unchanged. Their P3 state roots may hit the same code-pin break if created before this p2_owner.py byte change; they must recreate or deliberately migrate roots.
